zh.title: 雙十節連假離島管制航線將於8月10日開放訂位
zh.summary: 台灣民航局宣布，民國115年雙十節3天連假的澎湖、金門及馬祖離島管制航線，將自8月10日上午9時起開放訂位。民航局在本次航空疏運期共規劃1,102架次、提供89,926個座位數，並提醒旅客尖峰時段機票設有限當日當班次等搭乘限制。
body: 交通部民用航空局宣布，民國115年雙十節連假之澎湖、金門、馬祖三離島管制航線，將自8月10日上午9時起統一開放訂位。本次疏運共提供1,102架次，計89,926個座位數。
本次雙十節連假自10月9日至10月11日共計3天，民航局規劃自10月8日至10月12日為期5天的航空疏運期。其中，澎湖航線提供498架次、36,828個座位數；金門航線470架次、44,018個座位數；馬祖航線134架次、9,080個座位數。
民航局提醒，針對10月8日至10月10日台灣往離島，及10月10日至10月12日離島回台灣之尖峰時段機票，均會加註「限當日當班次」等限制。

en.title: Booking for Double Tenth Holiday Flights to Remote Islands Opens August 10
en.summary: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration announced that ticket bookings for regulated flight routes to Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu during the 2026 Double Tenth Day holiday will open on August 10 at 9:00 AM. The holiday aviation transport period runs from October 8 to October 12, offering 1,102 flights and 89,926 seats. Flights to Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu will offer 36,828, 44,018, and 9,080 seats respectively. The authority also reminded travelers that tickets for peak periods will carry restrictions such as "valid only on the designated day and flight."
body: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) announced that bookings for regulated routes to Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu for the 2026 Double Tenth Day holiday will open on August 10 at 9:00 AM. A total of 1,102 flights offering 89,926 seats will be provided.

The holiday runs from October 9 to 11, with the transport period planned from October 8 to 12. The service includes 498 flights (36,828 seats) for Penghu, 470 flights (44,018 seats) for Kinmen, and 134 flights (9,080 seats) for Matsu.
Tickets for travel during peak periods—Taiwan to islands on October 8–10 and returning on October 10–12—will include restrictions such as "valid only on the designated day and flight."

facts.sourceQuote: 澎湖、金門、馬祖三離島管制航線將提供1,102架次，計89,926個座位數，並自8月10日(下週一)上午9時起開放訂位。

facts.claim: The aviation transportation period for the Double Tenth Day holiday is planned from October 8 to October 12, 2026, for a total of 5 days, while the holiday itself is a 3-day period from October 9 to October 11.
facts.sourceQuote: 今年雙十節假期自115年10月9日(週五)至115年10月11日(週日)有3天連假，民航局規劃，10月8日(週四)至10月12日(週一)為航空疏運期，共計5天。

facts.claim: The flight allocations are 498 flights (36,828 seats) for the Penghu route, 470 flights (44,018 seats) for the Kinmen route, and 134 flights (9,080 seats) for the Matsu route.
facts.sourceQuote: 澎湖航線498架次、36,828個座位數；金門航線470架次、44,018個座位數；馬祖航線134架次、9,080個座位數

facts.claim: Tickets for travel during peak periods from Taiwan to the islands on October 8–10 and returning on October 10–12 will carry a restriction of being valid only on the designated day and flight.
